{{Top|leg}}
The '''Proponents for a Standard Revised Galactic Continuity''' was an organization that existed during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The organization once complained to the Republic about the [[holowright]] [[Peshosloc]]'s works on the subject of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], claiming that Peshosloc had changed the truth about historical events for the sake of entertainment value.
